An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "ええ、いいわよ。". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Relaxed, warm, honey-smooth adult conversational acknowledgement, calm and effortlessly poised. Stop completely silent immediately after the final syllable; no trailing breath, sigh, hum, or background noise.
